description: Off*Script Life OS — the companion app for the Life OS: Off*Script 2027 (Chaos Year Edition) planner. Daily chaos prompts, morning/midday/evening check-ins, all 365 days of 2027 stamped with their real holiday, and Ask Mei — an AI co-pilot that reads your recent entries and gives it to you straight. Plus the Chaos Wall, private DMs, Big 6 goals, weekly debriefs, money maps, anti-goals, Cosmic Corner horoscopes (Nice/Rude), chaos points and streaks. Slogan: Boredom=Death.
name: Off*Script Life OS
